channel.title: GTA 6 News: the official timeline, date by date | Leonidakit
channel.description: GTA 6 news: every official Rockstar announcement, from Trailer 1 to the launch trailer, with what it showed and its source.

item.title: The launch trailer
item.description: A trailer set to “Flower in a Hurricane”, Justice’s new single with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. Rockstar presents Justice as the composer of the game’s original score.

item.title: The Rockstar Store collection
item.description: Rockstar launches the Grand Theft Auto VI Collection, exclusive to its store: T-shirts, caps, keychains, a money clip, a Zippo lighter, tote bags and stickers.

item.title: The six radio stations
item.description: Rockstar presents Flash FM, Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6 and Dirty South Classics, their hosts, on-demand podcasts, and a radio you can also listen to on foot.

item.title: The Game Informer cover story
item.description: Game Informer reveals its GTA VI cover, then, on September 29, more than 170 animal species, according to Rockstar’s Michael Kane.

item.title: “The Goodtime State” collector’s box
item.description: A limited-edition box, without the game: eleven items inspired by the Macca the Gator show, from the figure to the Oakley sunglasses, up for pre-order while supplies last and arriving November 19.

item.title: The official album
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, 34 original tracks with Atlantic Records, coming out with the game; six are available on the day of the announcement.

item.title: Two controllers in GTA VI colors
item.description: PlayStation unveils two limited-edition DualSense controllers, one black and one white, out November 19 at a suggested price of €84.99; pre-orders on September 10 at 10:00 local time.

item.title: Rob Nelson’s interview with Famitsu
item.description: Rob Nelson of Rockstar North answers Famitsu’s questions after the demo: shops and salons, outfits, gang hideouts, witnesses and alarms.

item.title: An Extended Look
item.description: A presentation of about 26 minutes, first on Netflix and then on YouTube, captured on PS5: missions, car theft, robberies, police and Jason and Lucia’s daily life. Rockstar then adds new screenshots to its site.

item.title: The press previews
item.description: Journalists describe the demo presented by Rob Nelson: the story that starts in the Keys, the size of Vice City, the lived-in safehouses.

item.title: The boxed version in detail
item.description: Rockstar Support updates its page on the editions: the box contains a download code, no disc, available from November 12 for preloading, and there’s no boxed Ultimate Edition.

item.title: The date for An Extended Look
item.description: Rockstar announces An Extended Look: premiering on Netflix on Thursday, August 27 at 15:00 New York time (21:00 in France), then on YouTube and the game’s site at 21:00 New York time.

item.title: Pre-orders, Ultimate Edition and Vintage Vice City Pack
item.description: Rockstar announces that pre-orders open on June 25, at midnight, local time, and presents the Ultimate Edition and the Vintage Vice City Pack. On the same day, PlayStation presents the PS5 as the best place to play the game.

item.title: The pre-order date and the cover art
item.description: Rockstar announces that pre-orders open on June 25, on digital stores and at select retailers, and reveals the official cover art in a video.

item.title: The November 19, 2026 release date
item.description: Rockstar announces the release for Thursday, November 19, 2026, to finish the game to the desired level of polish.

item.title: Trailer 2, the characters and the regions
item.description: On the same day, Rockstar releases Trailer 2, the pages for the eight characters, the six regions of Leonida and the first official screenshots.

item.title: Trailer 1
item.description: The first video introduces Lucia, the State of Leonida and Vice City, over “Love Is a Long Road” by Tom Petty.
